# VisuStella Elements & Status Menu Core

Plugin Tier 1 para RPG Maker MZ. Controle de dano elemental, Trait Sets e Status Menu.

## Areas Principais

- conceitos/ - Visao geral, calculo elemental, multi-elemento, trait sets
- notetags/ - Elementos, JS elementos, trait sets, biografia, referencia rapida
- comandos/ - Plugin commands ator/inimigo, script calls
- parametros/ - Element rulings, status menu, categorias, trait sets
- referencia/ - Formulas, glossario

## Ordem de Navegacao

1. conceitos/visao-geral.md
2. conceitos/calculo-dano-elemental.md
3. conceitos/multi-elemento.md
4. conceitos/trait-sets.md
5. notetags/referencia-rapida.md
6. Demais arquivos por necessidade

## Conceitos-Chave

- **Trait Sets**: 10 tipos (Element, SubElement, Gender, Race, Nature, Alignment, Blessing, Curse, Zodiac, Variant)
- **Formula Dano**: (base + plus) * rate + flat
- **Multi-Element Rules**: Maximum, Minimum, Multiply, Additive, Average
- **Element Operations**: Absorb, Reflect, Pierce, Force
